messages:
Eli S: Heads-up: ZENFLOW (acct: ZEN-77) invoice INV-8122 for $6,720 is 62 days overdue. Dunning email bounced (mailbox full) and CC on file is unreachable.
Maria H: Oof. Any contractual net terms?
Eli S: Contract says net-30. Renewal team says account flagged for churn but still active. CS reported a disputed usage item for May - customer claims overage billing is incorrect.
Maria H: Okay, open a short investigation on the usage dispute, but we need to protect cash flow. Can we request a partial payment pending dispute resolution? Suggest asking for 50% now to avoid escalation, remainder held until usage audit completes.
BillingBot: Automated retry attempted for INV-8122. Payment method: card-ending-4242. Declined: insufficient_funds. Next retry in 72 hrs.
Eli S: I can request 50% and offer to pause non-critical features if they don't commit. Also will ask for AP contact via alternate email.
Sam R (Legal): We can accept a partial payment arrangement provided the disputed amount is documented and the plan states withheld funds will be released upon audit outcome. No waiving of fees unless approved by Legal.
Maria H: Good. Draft message to send to billing@zenflow with cc to their AM and legal: 
"We acknowledge your dispute re: May overage. To avoid service interruption, please remit 50% ($3,360) within 7 business days and provide the AP contact. We will freeze the disputed line item and complete an audit within 14 business days. If audit reduces the charge, remaining balance will be adjusted accordingly. If audit confirms charges, remaining balance will be due within 7 days. Failure to remit the partial payment may result in suspension per contract."
Eli S: Sending now. I'll also escalate to AM to grab alternate contact.
CS Bot: Opened ticket CS-9882 linking to INV-8122 and flagged for usage audit. Owner: Priya M.
BillingBot: Payment link sent to billing@zenflow: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-8122.
Eli S: AP replied with alternate billing contact billing@zenflow-payables.com and said they will review with finance. No immediate payment confirmation.
Maria H: Mark invoice status -> "Under Dispute - Partial Payment Requested". If we don't receive 50% in 7 business days, loop collections.
BillingBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up on INV-8122 on 1742600000.
Maria H: Thanks team. Keep threads open and update CS ticket when audit completes. If dispute not resolved in 30 days, we'll consider escalation to collections. :thumbsup:
